## About
Western Auto Crafters is a collision repair, auto body and paint center in the heart of Los Angeles. Marko founded the shop and has spent his working life in auto collision, and customers often mention him by name.
Our goal is simple: make your collision repair as easy as possible. We're a direct repair shop for a long list of insurance companies, we work on all makes and models, and we'd like you to leave happy with the car you get back.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs after an accident, big or small, handled with you from drop-off to pickup.
- Auto body and paint: Body work and paint to get your car looking the way it should.
- Door dings, fender benders and major accidents: Small dings or serious damage, bring it in and we'll take a look.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We're a direct repair shop for a number of insurers, including USAA, Nationwide, AIG Insurance, Allied Insurance, Harleysville Insurance and others. Call us and we'll let you know.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: All makes and models. One reviewer noted that Benz repairs are a specialty, but said not to let that deter you no matter what you drive.

Q: Do you stand behind your repairs?
A: Our site lists a lifetime guarantee. Ask us about the details when you bring your car in, and if anything seems off after pickup, just get back in touch.
